quote: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: Within twenty feet of any marked crosswalk.

activation.condition: A vehicle is within twenty feet of a marked crosswalk.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park a vehicle in the specified place, subject to the exact source qualifications.

exceptions.trigger: Necessary traffic conflict, law compliance, or officer/device direction applies.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Follow the applicable law or direction.
exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device

timing.description: During the observed stop, stand or park; no statutory duration is stated.
